aha: The piranha shafts with pits take the stones. The shaft without a pit takes the PEARL, which crushes that piranha and lands on the road. Do it in order: right of the start you cannot reach the stones, so first run the road under the live piranhas (timing) and climb the zig-zag middle shaft. Push the left stone first, because the moment you open the cell beside it, it rolls into the middle shaft and wedges.
deadlocks: Pushing the pearl first (it sits right next to the start): it blocks the road and the plateau is split, so the stones can only be reached with a long recovery trick (pass under it, nudge it right, climb the emptied shaft).
Digging toward the right stone before pushing the left one: the left stone rolls into the middle shaft, wedges, and the left pit can never be plugged (unwinnable).
Pushing the pearl along the road before both pits are plugged: it drops into a pit.
Lingering on the road under a live piranha's shaft, or digging the plateau next to a piranha's gap cell: it bites.
